_comment: Vector Search index using Atlas Automatic Embedding (EMBEDDING_STRATEGY=atlas). Atlas generates and stores embeddings from 'chunkText' on every insert/update, and embeds query strings at search time - so editing a record automatically updates its vector with no re-seed. Requires a voyage-4 family model (voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-4-large, voyage-code-3). Create in Atlas UI: Database > Search > Create Index > JSON Editor > Vector Search. Index name must match ATLAS_VECTOR_INDEX (default 'vector_index').
